The '''FT-8 Star Guard''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[FT-series]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] starfighters produced by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. Similar to other models of the series, the Star Guard had two wings and two rear engines, and it featured a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] on each wing. The Star Guard was a redesign of the older [[FT-5A Honor Guard]] model.<ref name="GS" />
